components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main conversion action for free check or service inquiry.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.65rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #d8ff72; color: #091018; font-family: Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 800; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.65rem; box-shadow: 0 16px 44px rgba(216,255,114,0.24); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(216,255,114,0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d8ff72; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting navigation action that should not compete with the primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 2.65rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: #f5f7fb; font-family: Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 800; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.28); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8ad7ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Reusable dark service panel for meaningful content groups.
components.html:
온라인 점검

구글, 홈페이지, SNS를 함께 봅니다.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 1.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); background: rgba(9,13,19,0.78); color: #f5f7fb; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.2), 0 8px 32px rgba(138,215,255,0.08); font-family: Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0; font-family: Outfit, Pretendard, sans-serif; font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.04em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: #a8b1c7; line-height: 1.7; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark form field for inquiry and diagnostic forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.7rem; font-family: Pretendard, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #f5f7fb; } .ds-field span { color: #7f8ba3; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: #f5f7fb; padding: 0.85rem 0.95rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: rgba(216,255,114,0.45); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(216,255,114,0.08); }

components.name: Scope Chip

narrative.overview: GoodmanSEO should feel like a calm, practical review desk for a small business owner who wants to know how their business looks online. The current interface is a dark, atmospheric brand site with glassy panels, lime and light-blue accents, rounded controls, and Korean-first typography.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tinted surfaces with bright but sparse accent use.
Rounded controls and panels, but no unnecessary nested-card scaffolding.
Practical hierarchy: problem, check scope, next action.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: Lime is for decisions and confirmation. If every section glows, nothing is important.

rules.name: The Short Korean Line Rule
rules.body: Homepage and service copy should use short, human Korean sentences. Do not pack multiple ideas into one sentence.

rules.name: The No Decorative Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass treatment must frame a real decision, form, offer, or content group. Do not add blur just to make a section feel designed.

dos: Do lead with the free online check and the customer-visible question.
Do keep Korean copy short, direct, and owner-friendly.
Do preserve the Google + website + Instagram + Facebook story.
donts: Don't make GoodmanSEO sound like a generic website-agency landing page.
Don't lead with abstract online structure consulting language.
Don't add long explanatory sections where a busy owner needs one clear next action.
Don't nest cards inside cards or turn every section into a floating card.
